title: python, multi-hunk: both-sides-add combine + f-string between hunks
base:
"""Application settings for the capybase service.

Centralizes tunables so they can be overridden in one place. The three
regions below (services list, service banner, feature gates) are each
edited independently by different branches to exercise multi-hunk merges.
"""


# --- runtime tuning -----------------------------------------------------
# The set of subsystems started at boot. Order is not significant.
ENABLED_SERVICES = ["core", "cli"]


# --- service identity ---------------------------------------------------
# Exposed via the /health endpoint and the startup banner.
class ServiceConfig:
    name = "capybase"
    version = "0.1.0"

    def banner(self):
        return f"{self.name} (v{self.version})"


# --- feature gates ------------------------------------------------------
# Coarse on/off switches; flip a value to "on" to enable a subsystem.
FEATURE_FLAGS = {
    "cache": "off",
    "metrics": "off",
}
